Agnes: "Oh, from my window, I saw Edda out in the street the night before you arrived."  [case board: #20]

Odette: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Dorian and Bartholomew is the Poisoner."  [case board: #24, #25]
Hollis: "I am compelled to question Dorian's standing. Odette's records tie them to the Poisoner."  [case board: #26]

Nisha: "I don't trust Bartholomew either. As Hollis said, odette's records tie them to the Poisoner."  [case board: #29]

Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 7 others out."  [case board: #30, #31]
